notes.title: Update 1.4.2 LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:

[*] Creative levels now need to have a description before you can upload them.
[*] Cities in creative mode can now only rotate 90 degrees to prevent problems with houses that spawn around the cities.
[*] Added that you can now brush decorations with an even lower density.
[*] Added three possible random cards to new creative levels by default: cheap rails, cheap bridges and heavy freight train.

[list]
[*] Fixed that diorama mode would persist in campaign levels after playing a creative level with diorama mode active.
[*] Fixed that the game might boot up a VR device or that it might crash if you have a VR device installed. (Please let us know if the issue persists!)
[*] Fixed that you could open a broken state of a level when you open a save of a creative level that has been deleted.
[*] Fixed various models not turning red on invalid locations in creative mode
[*] Fixed that clicking the “open level page in browser” would sometimes give the browser a wrong URL.
[*] Fixed that the “sort by” dropdown in the mod browser would add additional dropdown entries on reopening the mod browser.
[*] Fixed that the density setting didn’t do enough for “dense forest” and “impenetrable rocks”. 
[*] Fixed that “no building connection” pins on stations would reappear when you removed them, by disabling and enabling the HUD or taking a Steam screenshot.
[*] Fixed that the controller becomes unresponsive during the credits.
[*] Fixed that the credits wouldn’t scroll all the way up before it disappears.
[*] Fixed that changing the graphics options using a controller wouldn’t save the new options.
[*] Fixed that animals would sometimes be invisible while placing them in creative mode.
[*] Fixed various texts and naming improvements.
[*] Fixed various localization issues in which the text wouldn’t fit in their box.
[/list]

notes.title: Laying Tracks for the Road Ahead!
notes.notes:
Hello conductors, 
2023 was a spectacular first year for Galaxy Grove and our journey doesn’t end there. As we lay tracks for the year ahead, we wanted to share our roadmap for 2024 with you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/f892b9e872aecb7a83c3fad21ec30878b4a18d7c.png[/img]
[h2]Update 3[/h2]
The first stop is a brand-new region that we’ll be pulling into in March! 

We can't say too much about it just yet, but let's just say that Spring blooms spectacularly in this region, which makes it the perfect time to release it!

While we can’t confirm it yet, do you have any guesses about where we may be heading? Drop your best guesses in the comments below!

As it’s a new region, there’ll be new industries to discover, as well as new card types to be added to your deck! In total, there’ll be 5 new levels in this region, as well as a new tiny level, and a brand new level type that we’ll be releasing this update as well. 

💭 Speaking of, every region apart from Greenlands will be getting a brand new level! These are fun, creative levels inspired by whatever ridiculous ideas our level designers could dream up and we hope that you enjoy them as much as we did bringing them to life.  
[h2]
Update 4[/h2]
But the journey doesn't end there! As the seasons shift, so does our focus. This Summer, we're throwing open the cab doors and letting you climb into the conductor's seat with the arrival of creative mode!  
We're keeping the specifics under wraps for now, but trust us, the power to tailor your Station to Station experience is going to be a game-changer. 

Over the next few months, we’ll be able to give a more concrete date for this, but we couldn't be more excited to finally add creative mode to the game! We can't wait to see what you dream up on the rails.

- Galaxy Grove

notes.title: Cameras at the ready! Photo mode is here 📸
notes.notes:
Hello conductors,

Unleash your inner photographer in our brand new Photo Mode - out today! 

[previewyoutube=N4nAgxG_tpg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Photo Mode[/h2]
Hold on tight as this new update brings photo mode to the breathtaking world of Station to Station. 

As you adventure through the rolling hills of Greendale or travel to the untamed wilderness of the Wild West, you’ll be able to access photo mode at any moment. 

There are a variety of options to help you capture the perfect shot as well. Zoom, focus distance, and blur strength can add depth to your photos, while options like stopping the trains or hiding the interface help you line up the perfect shot. 

Photo Mode also comes with the option to follow a specific train on its journey, as well as a ride-along option to give you the full experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/6aea030660df313eeb64f3017f1e31888e33f794.png[/img]

[h2]Tiny Levels[/h2]
Our December update also brings with it four new tiny levels across the existing regions. 

These bite-sized levels aren’t required to progress through the campaign but add fun additional challenges to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/5e08d49aa5720bc99da0676537243526820febb8.png[/img]

[h2]Custom Mode[/h2]
But that’s not all! We’ve also revamp Custom Mode to add even more options to let you transform the game and personalise your custom levels. 

Custom Mode now has four main categories to experiment with:
[list]
[*][b]LEVEL options[/b] let you customise the shape, size, and height to increase or reduce the difficulty of your map. 
[*][b]INDUSTRY types[/b] let you select what industry you’d like to appear, and how closely they’ll be grouped together. 
[*][b]The GRAPHICS[/b] can also be changed letting you choose the biome, weather, and number of animals you want in your custom world.
[*]The final section, [b]RAILROADS[/b], affects the cost of your railroads, how much they are allowed to curve, and their maximum slope.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/1cb4331c7fc393eebaa2b546260bac102ef6dec0.png[/img]

This is our last update of 2023 and we hope you’ll enjoy these new additions to Station to Station! The fun doesn’t stop there though as we will be back in 2024 with even more updates for the game. 

We hope to see you then,

- Galaxy Grove

Hello conductors, 

We’re thrilled to announce that our new update is out now!

notes.title: Devlog #4: Meet the Trains of Station to Station
notes.notes:
Hello conductors and welcome back to another devlog! 

With our launch date now confirmed (October 3rd, 2023 in case you don’t know), we thought this was a great opportunity to go through all of the trains you can expect to see in the game at launch.
 
Every train in Station to Station is based on a real train, so we’ll also be going through all of the inspirations for our trains, as well.

[h2]Freight Train - Inyo[/h2]
The first train you’ll encounter in Station to Station is our freight train, inspired by the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virginia_and_Truckee_22_Inyo]Virginia and Truckee Railroad No. 22[/url]. 

It was first built in 1875 and pulled both passenger and freight trains, although in Station to Station it only transports freight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/ca25f103cea203f03dc75f63c375cc3990c53cba.png[/img]

[h2]Heavy Freight Train - DR 89 6024[/h2]
The next train you’ll discover is inspired by the [url=https://www.dampflokmuseum.de/en/the-museum/exponate/sturdy-and-economical]DR 89 6024[/url]. Based on the Prussian class T 3 locomotives this three-axle steam locomotive was developed by Henschel & Sohn for private and industrial railways.

It is used to represent our Heavy Freight train in Station to Station, which gives you a bonus for the amount of freight transported by one rail. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/c0c014e2501f7288508ee4dfc5af2211903662fa.png[/img]

[h2]Passenger Train - Grote Groene[/h2]
When you enter Sunscorch Sands you’ll unlock the Passenger mechanic, which brings with it a brand new train! 

The Big Green is our team’s favorite train inspired by the [url=https://www.spoorwegmuseum.nl/en/ontdek/de-collectie/our-trains/grote-groene-ss-326/]Grote Groene (SS 326)[/url] and it’s currently housed at the Spoorwegmuseum near our office. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/619b3228dc0f456971df5789b14b786e396bc8a1.png[/img]

[h2]Luxury Passenger Train - Crampton[/h2]
The Sunscorch Sands region will also introduce you to the luxury passenger train! 

This train will give you a 50% bonus for each passenger it transports and is inspired by the [url=https://preservedbritishsteamlocomotives.com/4-2-0-ser-crampton/]Crampton 4-2-0[/url]. This steam locomotive was used across Great Britain, France, and Germany in the mid to late 1800s. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/84ae16952ad65ce41e00043f7859e8f8d18fd6f7.png[/img]

[h2]Mountain Train - Darjeeling Express[/h2]

We love trains with unique colors, so we had to add the gorgeous blue [url=https://artsandculture.google.com/story/the-iconic-steam-locomotives-of-the-darjeeling-himalayan-railway-darjeeling-himalayan-railway-society/5gUhwHBKgPprIQ?hl=en-GB]Darjeeling Express[/url] to Station to Station. 

The Darjeeling Express is used for the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway and climbs from about 100 m (330 ft) above sea level to about 2,200 m (7,200 ft), making it the perfect locomotive for our Mountain train. 

Use this train when climbing hilly terrain for a bonus! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/963f32fe2ae3ac0b5dc0149d6bc4d1db18fb38e8.png[/img]

[h2]Mixed Train - Merddin Emrys[/h2]

Next up is the [url=https://www.festipedia.org.uk/wiki/Merddin_Emrys]Double Fairlie Merddin Emrys[/url], named after the legendary Welsh wizard Merlin!

This double-engined locomotive is still in use today on the Ffestiniog Railway and we thought it was the perfect choice for our mixed train! A mixed train can carry both freight and passengers between two locations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/dc6f26cc649debab2acb4a9b8f2acc95965efd2c.png[/img]

[h2]Express Train - Bristol and Exeter Railway 4-2-4T[/h2]
Our final train is introduced in Region 5 (Golden Dunes) and is inspired by the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bristol_and_Exeter_Railway_4-2-4T_locomotives]Bristol and Exeter Railway 4-2-4T[/url]. 

This train can almost reach 90 mph at full speed, which makes it perfect for our express train! Our express train is the fastest train in Station to Station and is used to transport passengers quickly from city to city! Use this train for traveling long distances, and get a nice little bonus for doing so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/818c21f65475cfc19ea4de2b6498fe787a22935c.png[/img]

And that’s it! 

What do you think of the trains that will be included in the launch of Station to Station? Which one is your favourite? 

There are less than two weeks to go until Station to Station launches! We’re in full bug-swatting mode now but we have one more surprise before launch that we’ll be announcing next week.
 
We hope to see you then. 

- Galaxy Grove

notes.title: Devlog #2: We’re taking your feedback on board!
notes.notes:
Hello conductors, 

When we released our demo for Steam Next Fest, we asked you to provide feedback and you definitely delivered! We’ve had over 700 responses to our feedback survey, not to mention all the Steam discussion threads, and Discord posts. 

We’ve read every single piece of feedback and we wanted to share some of the things you suggested that have already made it into the game. 

If you haven’t already filled out our feedback form, [url=https://forms.gle/j6rLxScGRGfzE2LG9]you can do that here[/url]! 

[h2]Future Building Markers[/h2]
This was a big one for players! 

Being able to plan ahead is very important, so we’ve added building markers to every level. In the future, new buildings will replace these resource piles, which should help to plan better going forward.

If you've already played a level, the marker will show which building will appear there. If you haven't played a level, the text will say “Something is under construction.” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/6ed5e4fc1ed9b1fee383a8b7c671784be6252935.png[/img]

[h2]Water[/h2]
No world is complete without water! 

While you can’t dive into this beautiful blue, your trains can choo-choo over and around it. We’re adding a range of different water features to levels for you to navigate, including rivers, lakes, and oceans! 

This will also add new features for you to contend with, like expensive water bridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/cc5b33a5c1292f2e1edf03ca885a8526b78e29f3.png[/img]

[h2]Intersecting Tracks[/h2]
This was another great suggestion that should really help to lessen the impact of bad planning or, simply, mistakes.

In later levels, you’ll unlock special cards that will let you intersect tracks. This will let trains cross over each other’s railroads, reducing the need for a costly bridge and letting you easily access areas that may accidentally have been closed off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/62d392324e05c1161763bd53e082ab92b6de8b22.png[/img]

[h2]PickUps [/h2]
This was a really fun idea from one of our Discord members and we loved it! 

In certain locations around the map, there will be “Abandoned Goods” that a player can collect by building a railroad through them. These will provide you with more money if you’re willing to go to the trouble of collecting them. 

This idea adds a little extra challenge for players and encourages them to not always use the easiest route.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/78de277a8ed0c285118f622bf6e25b975fa30bea.png[/img]

These are just the first changes we’re making to the game based on your feedback! Outside of these, we’re also adding more industries, train types, and biomes to the game for you to discover! 

Last week we reached 120,000 wishlists, which is beyond incredible to us and, if you haven't already seen, we're looking for Playtesters! [url=http://discord.gg/Cw7UV5ECjw]Make sure to join our Discord[/url] and fill out the form there to get involved.

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Station to Station Gameplay
notes.notes:
Hello conductors,

Welcome to our first official devlog for Station to Station! 

Firstly, we wanted to say a big thank you so much to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hHPF2g1HyLs]Wholesome Direct[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=exHF5eA8zpA]Future Game Show[/url] for sharing a first look at the gameplay for our little train game! 

If you missed it, here’s the video. Or keep scrolling if you’d rather read a more detailed explanation. 

[previewyoutube=nTqlemlgTzw;full][/previewyoutube]

And, if you haven’t already, why not download and play the Station to Station demo? It’s live on our Steam page now and lets you try out the first three levels of the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2378470

[h2]Starting a new level[/h2]
Every level of Station to Station starts with a handful of rural buildings. Each building has resource requirements. For example, a mill needs wheat to make flour. 

Your job is to build a railway network that connects buildings to the resources they need. You do this by building stations and laying tracks that connect those stations. 

But you’re on a budget. Every station costs money to build. The longer your railroad, the more money it costs, and bridges cost extra money. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/4b693a111787c044b8424bc45632f2d244aaa3a0.gif[/img]

In each level, you’ll also receive a handful of cards with a number of uses. Cards like [i]Cheap rails [/i]and [i]Cheap bridges[/i] can be used to save money on construction. These are especially useful if you’re trying to complete the optional challenges.

There are also cards that offer you special trains, like the [i]Heavy Freight Train[/i] card. This card doubles the money you earn from building a connection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/f2ec78f6c28b20c1a7e278702f6d7968875e310e.png[/img]

Your goal for each level is to connect every building with the resources it needs to run. For every complete building, you’ll gradually populate a beautiful and ever-brightening landscape

Then connect these buildings to a city in order to share the produce with them. This will help your city grow and thrive! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/990a94d0c06ea4c540dc5a987b12d9acb393f96d.gif[/img]

That’s a very brief overview of Station to Station and the main features you can expect from the first few levels. 

[b]If you’re going for the high scores then here are some tips to get you started: [/b]

[list]
[*] You don’t need to directly connect each building. A train will travel through multiple stations in order to reach its destination. 
[*] Try connecting your buildings in a different order to get a higher Stack Bonus. 
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the Station to Station demo and please [url=https://forms.gle/o6LugaSBBL5bz3bH8]fill out our feedback form[/url] so we can make the full game even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/19003b22959887647b03449f2ab56d46b6aa6c36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/4b693a111787c044b8424bc45632f2d244aaa3a0.gif[/img]

It’s possible to get a gigantic stack bonus of over 750 in the third level, and any achievers of this will receive a [url=https://discord.gg/Cw7UV5ECjw]special role in our Discord[/url] to show their prowess!
